briefTitle: Sexual Function Outcomes Following Peri-clitoral PRP
officialTitle: Sexual Function Outcomes Following Peri-clitoral PRP Added to Anterior Vaginal Wall PRP: A Randomized Controlled Trial

arms.label: Anterior Vaginal Wall PRP + Periclitoral Sham
arms.description: All participants in this arm will receive active PRP injection into the anterior vaginal wall; they will receive a sham injection into the peri-clitoral sites.

arms.label: Anterior Vaginal Wall PRP + Periclitoral PRP
arms.description: All participants in this arm will receive active PRP injection into the anterior vaginal wall; they will receive active PRP injection into the peri-clitoral sites.

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults 18 years of age or older who were assigned female at birth
* Sexually active, with at least one episode of sexual activity (alone or with a partner) in the past month
* English speaking
* Able to complete study questionnaires
* Willing to undergo blood draw and genital injection procedure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant, suspected pregnancy, or breastfeeding/lactating
* Active infection
* Autoimmune condition
* History of pelvic radiation
* History of pelvic malignancy
* Current use of anticoagulant medication
* Prior urogenital platelet-rich plasma injection
* History of female genital mutilation/cutting
* Presence of urethrovaginal mesh (including midurethral sling)
* Chronic or acute pelvic pain preventing pelvic examination
* Active genital infection
